m.d: A yield is how much of a crop is grown in a year.
m.e: This year's harvest had a good yield.

m.d: To yield is to give way to someone or something else
m.e: Cars yield to the walkers when the walkers are in the crosswalk.

m.d: To yield is to produce something.
m.e: Most of the time, stocks yield more money than the original cost.

m.d: A yip is a sharp, high-pitch bark.
To yip is to bark with a sharp, high-pitched voice.
